set.body: Measured on exact main e4bbf5b in a disposable ordinary clone; public UnbalancedSinkhorn.solve returns successful SinkhornResult values for invalid numeric inputs. cost NaN and cost -Inf -> Right all-zero plan after 200 iterations, converged=false. row or column marginal NaN and negative finite values are silently treated like zero target mass and return an ordinary-looking partial plan with converged=true. row or column marginal +Inf -> Right all-zero plan after 200, converged=false. This is separate from the whole SinkhornConfig boundary in bd-01M174W3J09YF6Q733GDSQFHDZ. Required contract: marginals must be finite and nonnegative; costs must refuse NaN and -Inf. Cost +Inf is a deliberate decision point rather than an automatic rejection: the current algorithm treats it as a forbidden edge with zero mass and converges, so either document and test that meaning or refuse it explicitly. Use existing AlignError vocabulary unless chief rules otherwise. Acceptance needs named input-class laws, lawful zero marginal controls, and old-guard mutation evidence. Evidence: coordination post-01M17G6Y5TJ003F4SFYGM9FPN2.
set.title: align: Sinkhorn solve accepts invalid costs and marginals as successful transport
